analysis_kind: Arithmetic on already published P11 results and arrays. No new model forward, physics or tests.
units: height m; vertical velocity m/s; root SO3 and joint RMSE rad; time s.
scope: P11 models on seven fixed P10 hard27000 real action windows; same-input dynamics study, not current-policy rollout or population distribution.

analysis.input_policy: Fixed P10 hard27000 executed failure-tail actions, same physical initial state/reference/context
analysis.threshold_note: 0.1/0.5 probability and 0.9/0.5 survival are descriptive selection points only; no training change
